title: CAS-DAAD-Programme / Joint Fellowship Programme for Doctoral Students of CAS
summary: Provides young Chinese doctoral students from UCAS and CAS research institutes a research stay of 12 to 22 months in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Doctoral candidates or participants in a combined Master and PhD programme who commenced their studies at least one year before.

subject_areas.notes: Disciplines not explicitly restricted or specified as all.

institutions.notes: A German institution of higher education or research institution, with the exception of Max-Planck or Fraunhofer institutes

nationality.notes: Up and coming young Chinese scientists

residence.notes: Candidates who are living and applying from China, PR (UCAS and CAS research institutes).

mandatory.text: Doctoral candidates or participants in a combined Master and PhD programme who commenced their studies at least one year before.
No more than three years should have been passed since the starting of doctoral studies or the combined Master and PhD programme.
Language qualifications: English (IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL iBT 80) or German (DSH II / TestDaF 4x4 or higher).

exceptions.text: Doctoral students with a confirmed job offer for after their PhD may not apply.

funding.description: A monthly scholarship payment of 1,350 euro from UCAS in the first year, 1,200 euro from DAAD in the second year. Health, accident and personal liability insurance. A lump sum travel allowance.

application_rounds.notes: The application occurs online through the DAAD Portal in the period between 4 November and 4 December.

required_documents.text: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form
Extensive and detailed description of the research proposal agreed upon with academic adviser (signed by German host professor)
Schedule of planned research work (signed by German host professor)
Letter confirming supervision by an academic adviser in Germany
Declaration from the scientific supervisor in Germany on safety-relevant and ethical aspects
Admission to doctoral programme in China (if available)
University degree certificate indicating final grades (Bachelor and Master)
Certificate of knowledge of German or English language
Two recent, supporting letters of recommendation from university lecturers

steps.text: Request recommendation form in the DAAD Portal as a writable PDF and have it completed
Prepare application documents and translations if necessary
Fill out application form and upload documents in PDF format to the portal
